Strategy: Score peaks when the leftover after placement equals half the current item, falling linearly as the leftover moves away, so the rule favors bins leaving a medium residual rather than the tightest fit. It can differ from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin leaves a residual far from half the item. It may help by preserving near-exact bins for later items, or fail if medium residuals fragment capacity.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs((r - item) - item / 2) for r in bins]
```
